title: Dual-Face Z-Check Construction
construction: Use signed vertex-star rows as the Szilassi-dual face checks of the K12 triangular surface. Each edge i<j has +1 at vertex i and -1 at vertex j over GF3.

parameters.candidate_code: [[66,13,3]]_3 in the finite GF3 matrix model

comparison_to_BT1865: BT1865's six distance rows failed CSS commutation. The signed dual-face/vertex-star rows commute because they implement boundary-of-boundary cancellation on the oriented K12 surface.
boundary: Exact finite GF3 CSS matrix code. Physical decoding, optical measurement schedule, and hardware noise thresholds remain open.
